title: Driver Earnings Terms, Clause 7: Scheduled Weekly Payouts
content:
**7.1** Under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro**, payouts are sent only from an earnings account that is active, or closed with a balance to settle.

**7.2** Each earnings week, the balance available at the week's end is paid out on the payout weekday, Tuesday, to the payout method on file when it is at least the smallest scheduled payout of 0.01; a lower or negative balance carries forward and is recovered from later earnings before any payout.

**7.3** *Retired clause.* The former clause under which, when a payout hold was lifted, the balance held was paid out at once as a hold-release payout instead of waiting for the next week, is no longer in force; payment on the lifting of a payout hold is governed by the current hold-release basis of the product.

**7.4** When the account closes with a positive balance, it is paid out as a final payout on closing.

**7.5** Payouts are never sent while the account is on hold, and support does not send off-cycle payouts for any other reason.

## Clause 7.1 and 7.5 by account status

| Earnings account status | Payout sent? |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes, on the weekly schedule |
| Closed, with a balance to settle | Yes, a positive balance as the final payout on closing |
| On payout hold | No |
| Awaiting payout setup | No |

## Clause 7.2 on both sides of the floor

| Balance available at the end of the earnings week | Outcome on the Tuesday |
|---|---|
| 0.01 or more | Paid out to the payout method on file |
| 0.00 | Not sent; carries forward |
| Negative | Not sent; carries forward and is recovered from later earnings before any payout |

**Hypothetical case.** A week ends with an available balance of -12.40. Nothing is sent that Tuesday. If the next week adds 80.00 of earnings, the -12.40 is recovered from them first, and 67.60 is available at that week's end and paid out the following Tuesday.
